title: AI in Action: Strategies for Modern Healthcare - Orthopedics Edition
summary: This webinar covers how AI supports the pace and complexity of orthopedic care, from exam-heavy visits to procedures, imaging, and follow-ups.
body_markdown:
This webinar covers how AI supports the pace and complexity of orthopedic care, from exam-heavy visits to procedures, imaging, and follow-ups.


You’ll learn how practices are:
• Cutting charting time by over 90%
• Generating structured MSK notes automatically
• Improving coding accuracy and provider productivity
• Closing charts faster without after-hours work


If you want a clear view into how ambient AI fits into actual orthopedic workflows, this session is for you.


Watch the recorded session.
